source_origin: Synthetic deterministic known-grammar diagnostic, not real unfamiliar source birth

observations.BIT_VETO_threshold_comment: At 0.32, admission requires <=81/256 incorrect CHECK bits; all eight diagnostics exceeded this threshold.

interpretation.limited_information_barrier: At 2 episodes, sparse interventions leave 16 indistinguishable known-grammar rules in all four replicates; by 24 episodes all 4 seeds identified each grammar rule. This proves identifiability only for these synthetic 8-bit-known-rule grammar classes, not for novel general causal laws.
interpretation.optimization_headroom: Both frozen architectures reduce FIT BCE substantially when the diagnostic increases training from 45 to 135 epochs, but neither achieves natural CHECK admission. Optimization remains a plausible contributor, not sole explanation.
interpretation.representation_capacity: The known-grammar symbolic solver can recover the synthetic law from the FIT episodes but is privileged with the exact law class; it is not a fair generally learned comparator, so the result cannot prove a recurrent model could represent or efficiently learn that law.
interpretation.causal_transfer: No actual source-born L/M or consumed scientific case was replayed, scored or used as model selection; zero actual unfamiliar-source transfer observations. A green engineering run is not scientific success.
interpretation.cpu_RSS: Diagnostic measured training CPU and Linux OS process RSS, but complete naturally matched native original-science resource nonregression was not demonstrated.
interpretation.next_substantive_priority: Before another first-use cohort: source-free, preregistered 2x2 ablation of hidden-state/role-binding expressive capacity versus optimizer across the exact same synthetic episodes with a genuinely trained strong grammar-unaware sequence comparator; freeze budgets and parity before measuring. Do not choose a new prospective source based on diagnostics until headroom is established.
